1041Transport services

pack_route tasks

dev-front/pack-route-tasks

Act as a parcel station dispatcher: decide which parcels go in which van and the stop order of each van to minimise driving time.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • joint packing and routing
  • operations research with agents
  • held-out city test split

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Valid plans score 0.2 + 0.8 exp(-g/0.5) from the gap to the reference driving time; invalid plans score 0.2 times the share of parcels delivered.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

from datasets import load_dataset
train = load_dataset("dev-front/pack-route-tasks", "v1", split="train")

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download dev-front/pack-route-tasks --repo-type dataset --local-dir pack-route-tasks

Framework documentation: Verifiers.

Evidence

Every reference plan was checked with the environment's validator at exactly the solver's cost.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
